propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit reachable from HEAD, when the implementation scans all history reachable from current HEAD regardless of merge status
The close precheck is conditional (fires only when file_impact is recorded and the completion gate is on) but docs present it as unconditional
The referencing-commit check accepts the ticket OR any transitive descendant, but docs do not clarify the descendant subtree scope
AGENTS.md never documents rebar transition --ref despite it being the sanctioned way to close a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree
The actual land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism, but docs attribute it to the precheck
